facts.name: rsh
facts.summary: Ruby that also runs command lines: one script for the logic and the commands
facts.description:
rsh is a script interpreter: Ruby with a shell layer. Write the logic in Ruby and the commands as command lines, in one file that starts with #!/usr/bin/rsh.

Pipes, redirections, jobs, traps and globbing work as in a shell; strings, arrays, hashes and blocks work as in Ruby. One program with its interpreter built in, under 3 MB, with a man page (man rsh).
